title: Z
overview:
Enter a hair-raising race for territory and resources, as you attempt to crush your opponent before he overpowers you. The fast and frantic action strategy game - Z

Commander Zod and his two carefree robots, Brad and Allen, lead the red robot army against the blue across five hostile planets. There is no harvesting or base building: each battlefield is split into territories, and you claim one by sending a unit to its flag. Holding territory gives you its factories, which keep turning out new robots and vehicles, and the more ground you hold, the faster they build.

Seize abandoned tanks and guns before the enemy does, push across the map and win by storming or destroying the enemy fort or wiping out their forces.

- Real-time strategy built on capturing territory
- Robot squads, vehicles and artillery to command
- Five planets of battles
- Password saves
- Works with a control pad or the Shuttle Mouse
